purpose: High-signal Google searches for original ATS job boards. Queries are regenerated with a rolling date filter.

groups.label: Full Stack
groups.query: ("Full Stack Engineer" OR "Full Stack Developer" OR "Software Engineer") ("TypeScript" OR "React" OR "Angular" OR "Node.js")

groups.label: Frontend
groups.query: ("Frontend Engineer" OR "Angular Developer" OR "React Developer") ("TypeScript" OR "Angular" OR "React")

groups.label: Applied AI
groups.query: ("AI Product Engineer" OR "Applied AI Engineer" OR "AI Software Engineer" OR "Full Stack Engineer") ("LLM" OR "GenAI" OR "AI" OR "TypeScript")

groups.label: Founding / Early Engineer
groups.query: ("Founding Engineer" OR "Founding Software Engineer" OR "Early Engineer" OR "First Engineer") ("TypeScript" OR "React" OR "AI")
